info.name: Astro + Payload + Medusa (Local)
info.description:
Full API surface for the astro-payload-medusa teaching stack.

RUN ORDER MATTERS. Folder 00 captures the admin JWT; 02 captures a product id and creates a review; 03 and 04 reuse it. Use the Collection Runner (or Newman) top to bottom, or run 00 and 02 first if you want to click individual requests.

Requires the 'Local (astro-payload-medusa)' environment. Regenerate its keys after `npm run db:reset` with `npm run postman:env`.

Negative cases (400/401/403/404) are included on purpose - they are where this stack's architecture is most visible.

item.name: 04 Astro BFF

request.description: 200 when both are reachable, 503 otherwise - usable as a readiness probe.
No credential sent by the caller. Astro adds the publishable key server-side - the whole point of a BFF.
Composition no single Medusa route offers: one endpoint, two upstream surfaces.

request.description:
Tails the three services' logs and normalises them to one shape.

Two formats: Astro writes JSON-lines with a real `level`, while Payload and Medusa print text whose level has to be GUESSED from the words in the line. That asymmetry is the argument for structured logging.

Dev-only: it reads the local filesystem, which works only because all three services share a machine.
